* A utility class, which works as both a factory class of a cancellation signal to cancel * all the completable objects. * *

TODO: Make this lock-free.

variables.name: mFutureList
variables.comment:
* List of {@link CompletableFuture}, which can be used to propagate {@link #cancelAll()} to * completable objects. * *

This will be lazily instantiated to avoid unnecessary object allocations.

methods.name: boolean tryRegisterFutureOrCancelImmediately(@NonNull CompletableFuture<?> future)
methods.comment:
* Tries to register the given {@link CompletableFuture} into the callback list if this * {@link CancellationGroup} is not yet cancelled. * *

If this {@link CancellationGroup} is already cancelled, then this method will immediately * call {@link CompletableFuture#cancel(boolean)} then return {@code false}.

* *

When this method returns {@code true}, call {@link #unregisterFuture(CompletableFuture)} * to remove the unnecessary object reference.

* * @param future {@link CompletableFuture} to be added to the cancellation callback list. * @return {@code true} if the given {@code future} is added to the callback list. * {@code false} otherwise.

methods.name: public void cancelAll()
methods.comment:
* Cancel all the completable objects created from this {@link CancellationGroup}. * *

Secondary calls will be silently ignored.

methods.name: public boolean isCanceled()
methods.comment: * @return {@code true} if {@link #cancelAll()} is already called. {@code false} otherwise.
